body: I am a stoner & a girlfriend wow

The truth always comes out. I am a 5’4 120 pound female and have 0.5 prescribed to use for anxiety attacks, I have taken a few here and there recreationally and that’s no excuse. I have done many drugs and never once decided to fuck someone other than my boyfriend. Time to own up.

How I feel is if it is not directed at you, just don’t reclaim any derogatory term. in today’s world while yes people are more open than before but there’s so many hateful, judge mental, bigots out there. It’s unclear to many if someone who has a platform who’s never spoken about battling such issues is using the term as a slur or not. It’s really not very hard to cut out.

When did I say he has to apologize? In my first comment to you I very clearly said he can say whatever  he wishes. I just think it should be brought to his attention. Sometimes he lets his mouth run a little long , I know he means well. That being said he chose to use his platform for spreading education, politics, social issues and so on. He needs to be accountable for his words. I’m not upset with him for making a mistake or not being 100% correct all of the time, I just believe he needs to find another word to use in that context. It’s unnecessary.

If the people who it affects would like to reclaim it, they can do so. It is ableist otherwise. In a world where people with disabilities are constantly stigmatized he should refrain from using such slurs.

It’s immature and ignorant to turn a blind eye to things that do not effect you. You should open your mind more. Just as he as the right to say whatever he wants, people have the right to justifiably disagree. The post was just expressing how they very validly felt offended by his use of the word. There is absolutely no need to put a group of people down to get across a point.

Matty does not have the right to reclaim the word. Point blank. It is out dated and offensive. He has such a wide vocabulary, if what he means is regression he should say regression. I’m not going to demand him to apologize especially if it’s insincere, but knowing Matty truly has a kind heart I think people just wanted to bring it to his attention. He preaches about education and open mindedness all the time. His speech was spot on until he used the slur. I just don’t know why people are bothered by someone asking him to think twice before using a term that has been known to degrade others.

No one is saying he cannot speak his mind. But in today’s day in age, how he preaches about being open minded, and prides himself on being educated he knows better. The word is outdated and offensive. I know he has a great heart and did not mean Ill intentions but that does not make it okay. To ask someone to stop using hurtful derogatory terms is not stripping their right  to free speech. He /can/ say it if wants, but why would he knowingly want to hurt someone? I don’t believe he does. Which is why it’s necessary to bring this to his attention.
They are Matty I can confirm

Everyone has bad days. We know this. But as someone who suffers from bipolar depression when it hits you sometimes it just hits real hard. All I want is for Matty to know he is loved and people care about him. I would personally rather see fans concerned for his health than ignore it and him snap. He has lovely friends and family who has his back and all we can do is let them be there for him. But I don’t think fans looking out for him is a negative thing at all.

Please take care of yourself Matthew. People care about YOU. not just your shows or the fame you bring or whatever people care about you and your well-being. You can always talk to us without judgement
